Recommended checks: Following error is how far the feed axis lags behind the position the controller commands, measured by the servo controller itself on every move. A healthy drive keeps it small, a few micrometres at normal load; a heavier cut or a faster speed adds a little; while a station is idle or stopped the drive only holds the axis still and the lag falls to about one micrometre, so compare running periods only. Check vibration, temperature and job times: a worn drive leaves them unchanged, while a worn spindle bearing raises vibration and heat and lengthens jobs (\u00a72.2), and a wrong speed changes job times at one moment and then holds them steady (\u00a72.7).
